facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/mobj:.sbss
facts.version_note: updated_at is the frozen fact version exposed by the API.
facts.value: All four slots begin in a null state. The current-material slot is overwritten on display entry and explicitly cleared on exit without restoring a prior value. The toon slot transitions from NULL to one lazily allocated reusable TObj whose image may subsequently change. The shadow slot is the head of a duplicate-free intrusive list that supports individual removal or full detachment. MObj class amnesia clears the default-class slot when its selected class is forgotten and clears both shared texture slots when the base MObj class is forgotten.
